title: Superselection Sectors of Braided Fusion Spin Systems
exact_target: Prove that the charge-sector equivalence with the input category's completion also preserves tensor product and braiding.

sources.citation: ULAM.AI and the UnsolvedMath Contributors, UnsolvedMath, record 30006353 (OWR-14299511-002). Catalogue curation under CC BY 4.0; definitions and English exposition added locally.

Subfactors and Applications (2025), Oberwolfach Reports, DOI 10.4171/owr/2025/34, pp. 1823--1886. Original report and mathematical context. Incorporated report material remains under the source CC BY-SA 4.0 terms unless otherwise noted.

status_qualification: The primary report already proves equivalence as a $W^*$ category. Its Conjecture 1 asks for equivalence as a $W^*$ braided tensor category, preserving tensor product and braiding. This additional structure is missing from the condensed catalogue wording below and constitutes the remaining conjecture.
